entries.originalText: I will hearken what the Lord God shall say within me.(1) Blessed is the soul which heareth the Lord speaking within it, and receiveth the word of consolation from His mouth.
entries.modernizedText: I will listen to what the Lord God says within me.(1) Blessed is the soul that hears the Lord speaking within it and receives the word of consolation from His mouth.

entries.originalText: Blessed are the ears which receive the echoes of the soft whisper of God, and turn not aside to the whisperings of this world.
entries.modernizedText: Blessed are the ears that receive the echoes of the soft whisper of God and do not turn aside to the whisperings of this world.

entries.originalText: Blessed truly are the ears which listen not to the voice that soundeth without, but to that which teacheth truth inwardly.
entries.modernizedText: Truly blessed are the ears that listen not to the voice that sounds outside, but to that which teaches truth inwardly.

entries.originalText: Blessed are the eyes which are closed to things without, but are fixed upon things within.
entries.modernizedText: Blessed are the eyes that are closed to things outside, but are fixed on things within.

entries.originalText: Blessed are they who search inward things and study to prepare themselves more and more by daily exercises for the receiving of heavenly mysteries.
entries.modernizedText: Blessed are those who search inward things and study to prepare themselves more and more by daily exercises to receive heavenly mysteries.

entries.originalText: Blessed are they who long to have leisure for God, and free themselves from every hindrance of the world.
entries.modernizedText: Blessed are those who long to have leisure for God and free themselves from every hindrance of the world.

entries.originalText: Think on these things, O my soul, and shut the doors of thy carnal desires, so mayest thou hear what the Lord God will say within thee.
entries.modernizedText: Think on these things, O my soul, and shut the doors of your carnal desires, so that you may hear what the Lord God will say within you.

entries.originalText: These things saith thy Beloved, “I am thy salvation, I am thy peace and thy life.
entries.modernizedText: Your Beloved says these things: “I am your salvation, I am your peace and your life.

entries.originalText: Keep thee unto Me, and thou shalt find peace.”
entries.modernizedText: Keep close to Me, and you will find peace.”

entries.originalText: Put away thee all transitory things, seek those things that are eternal.
entries.modernizedText: Put away from yourself all transitory things; seek those things that are eternal.

entries.originalText: For what are all temporal things but deceits, and what shall all created things help thee if thou be forsaken by the Creator?
entries.modernizedText: For what are all temporal things but deceits, and how will all created things help you if you are forsaken by the Creator?

entries.originalText: Therefore put all things else away, and give thyself to the Creator, to be well pleasing and faithful to Him, that thou mayest be able to attain true blessedness.
entries.modernizedText: Therefore put all other things away, and give yourself to the Creator, to be well pleasing and faithful to Him, so that you may be able to attain true blessedness.
